notes: The author asks in their own words for an open world to roam as an ant, and the answers make exploring and foraging the activity, so Adventure leads on world-open with the Exploration preset - a compact garden packed with zones that reads as vast at ant scale, given direction by oversized plants and stones as landmarks and threaded by worn trails between them. Roleplay & Avatar Sim is named second because you inhabit the world as a creature, and it supplies den-shelter for the colony the ant carries food back to, which Adventure has no row for. Added collectible-nodes for the food itself and npc-population for the many visible animals the answers say make the garden feel alive - those animals are ambient, not hostiles, so no spawner and no threat. I decided without asking that the colony is entered only at its mouth rather than being a generated interior, which keeps this off P3 and entirely on P0, and that the run has no end since foraging repeats.
